name: Industrie De Nora S.p.A.
summary: Industrie De Nora S.p.A., through its global subsidiaries, specializes in providing advanced catalytic coatings and durable insoluble electrodes for a wide range of electrochemical and industrial applications. Its extensive product catalog features analyzers, detectors, specialized anodes (for chlorine and oxygen evolution), cathodes (for hydrogen evolution), various disinfection and electro-chlorination systems, components for cathodic protection, sophisticated filtration solutions, gas diffusion electrodes, MEA, catalysts, membrane technologies, and contaminant removal systems. Beyond products, the company offers comprehensive support services, including engineering design, remote technical assistance, repair and analytical services, specialized training, electrode recoating, and the supply of essential spare parts. These innovative solutions are crucial for numerous critical processes, such as ballast water management, battery production, chlor-alkali processes, cooling and fire protection water treatment, copper foil electrodeposition, fuel cell development, hydrogen generation through water electrolysis, HCL electrolysis, marine and offshore wastewater treatment, pool disinfection, printed circuit board manufacturing, salt splitting, sodium chlorate production, surface disinfection, and diverse surface finishing, plating, and galvanizing operations, alongside general wastewater treatment and water reuse/reclamation. Industrie De Nora serves a diverse global clientele, encompassing commercial and institutional organizations, participants in the energy transition, engineering and construction firms, original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), food and beverage producers, industrial operations, marine sectors, mining and metal recovery, municipal drinking water and wastewater utilities, offshore and onshore oil and gas, power generation, pulp and paper, steel manufacturing, utilities, NGOs, and relief organizations, as well as specialized surface finishing industries. Established in Milan, Italy, in 1923, Industrie De Nora S.p.A. operates as a subsidiary of Federico De Nora S.P.A.
